summary: Defines a BGP capability that lets a speaker send its peer a set of Outbound Route Filters. The peer then applies those filters to limit which routes it sends back. This moves filtering to the sender, reducing the number of routing updates a router has to receive and discard, and it is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Instead of receiving all the junk mail and throwing it out, you give the post office a list of what you want. Then it only sends the right letters.

questions: how to filter routes at the sender in bgp
